logic.top_level: pathways (but written as one flat bullet list with OR on the first six bullets and AND on the rest; see ambiguity)

k_of_n.quote: includes 1 or more of the following: Anti-inflammatory medications / Analgesics / ... / Therapeutic injections into the knee as appropriate
Revision arthroplasty meets the definition of medical necessity when 1 or more of the following conditions exist

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Footnote list '*Contraindications for total and revision knee arthroplasty' (4 items) referenced by an AND bullet 'There are no contraindications*'. UKA embeds its own contraindication list as the last nested bullet under conservative management (mis-nested).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision arthroplasty has its own criteria list (disabling pain, bone loss, infection, loosening, wear, dislocation, instability). Failure of previous UKA or osteotomy is a pathway for TKA. No limit on second side/bilateral (statement on simultaneous bilateral deleted 12/15/22).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Failure of a previous osteotomy, OR ... Avascular necrosis of the knee, OR Proximal tibia fracture, OR Advanced joint disease demonstrated by radiographic or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) evidence of ... avascular necrosis), AND Pain or functional disability ... AND Failure of at least 3 months of conservative ... AND There are no contraindications*
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A flat bullet list mixes OR and AND. Reading 1: any of the 6 diagnoses alone suffices, OR the 'advanced joint disease' bullet plus pain plus 3 months conservative plus no contraindications (the intended reading from the lead-in 'one or more'). Reading 2: the trailing AND bullets apply to every diagnosis (then a distal femur fracture would require 3 months of conservative care). Reading 3: only the contraindication bullet applies to all ('for any indication above'). The text offers no indentation to resolve it.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: subchondral cysts, subchondral sclerosis, periarticular osteophytes, joint subluxation, joint space narrowing, avascular necrosis)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Unbalanced parenthesis; 'evidence of' list with no k stated, so one finding is enough by default. Avascular necrosis is both in the imaging list and its own pathway.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Revision ... Disabling pain or functional disability, OR ... Instability of the knee joint, AND There are no contraindications*
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Same pattern: AND after an OR list; the final AND presumably applies to the whole OR list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Failure of at least of 3 months of conservative non-surgical medical management ... includes all of the following: ... None of the following contraindications for unicompartmental arthroplasty are present
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A 'none of' contraindication list is nested inside the conservative-management 'all of' list as a sixth item, so a parser would read it as a conservative therapy component.

extraction_hazards: Bullets (•) and sub-bullets (o, ▪) carry the logic via indentation; pdftotext keeps indentation but OR/AND are in trailing words, so a parser must read the keywords at line ends.
Mis-nested list in UKA: contraindication list appears as a sixth item inside the conservative-management list.
Footnote markers (* and **) hold the contraindication list and the K-L scale below the criteria.

Description contains a ~100-line UpToDate quotation with words like 'contraindications', 'age', 'BMI' that are not criteria; keyword extraction will pick up false requirements (e.g., 'under the age of 50' caution, UKA 'ideal candidates... weighing less than 82 kg').
Typo 'Unicomparmental' heading; unbalanced parenthesis in imaging list.
Navigation bar text (Position Statement / Billing/Coding / ...) repeated in the header block.
interesting_structures: Three sub-policies in one section (TKA, revision, UKA) with different logic shapes: TKA OR-list-then-AND, revision OR-list-then-AND, UKA a straight AND list.
Same concept (conservative therapy) is 1-of-8 for TKA but all-of-5 for UKA: the more conservative operation gets stricter prerequisites.
No BMI, HbA1c, tobacco or age criteria at all; BMI > 40 contraindication was deleted 08/15/19 (history).
Step therapy exemption statement attached to the policy under Florida law.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Content is all/any/not, but the flat bullet list with OR then AND (TKA) needs a human decision about grouping, the UKA contraindications are mis-nested, and the leaves ('failure', 'reasonable', 'appropriate') are soft. The 8-way conservative-therapy menu is a clean 1-of-n.
